meta.title: Multiple suppliers invited at once with "Invite All Selected"

args.goal: on the displayed Vendor Finder results, select at least two vendor cards, click “Invite All Selected” at the bottom right, and stop when the screen shows that invitations were successfully sent to all selected vendors

steps.note: Performs and observes the bulk-selection invitation flow on the buyer's current screen.
Asserts that the invitation-sent success confirmation appeared.
